analysis_mode: descriptive supplementary profiling; prior main results already observed
authorization: User requested a short profiling supplement; local CPU only
question: Where does explicitly attributable function-exclusive CPU profile time accrue in unchanged fixed-seed audit implementations?
model_config: Original audited defaults; budget 200-step horizon, QGPF 100-step horizon, EC source module20 updates; preserve original RNG streams
order: Method-major and seed0,1,2; uninstrumented then cProfile; no timing-based exclusions
time_origin: Around unchanged filtering/module call; includes algorithm initialization and configured RNG creation, excludes input generation, JSON serialization, hashing, imports and I/O
time_estimand: Descriptive mean of each seed run function-exclusive percentages; not a phase-inclusive cost or benchmark estimate
bucket_method: Every cProfile function-exclusive time assigned once by declared function label; generic/shared NumPy helpers and mixed-purpose loop self time remain other. No inference from cumulative time.
primary_guardrail: Scientific output hash, including predictions, counters, histories and summaries, identical between instrumented and uninstrumented call after removing runtime_s and ess_per_second
failure_rule: Stop and preserve failure if any identity, frozen source hash, finite-output or threadpool check fails; no substitute seeds

environment.numpy_rng: Explicit default_rng/SeedSequence streams of original runners

limitations: Only3seed workloads and one paired timing per workload; elapsed durations vary with scheduler, caches and profiler overhead.
cProfile overhead is separately measured; profile shares must not replace original30seed wallclock results.
Function-exclusive labels are conservative: shared NumPy internals and mixed-purpose loops remain other; bucket shares do not measure complete algorithm phases.
QM rotate_bit_toward combines rotation and measurement; separate measurement timing unavailable. QGPF measurement and selection are inline in qgpf_resample and cannot be separately attributed.
EC source module is a20update one-step selection audit, not a complete EC-QPF filter.
Equal likelihood budgets do not imply equal wallclock costs. No equal-wallclock experiment, GPU or quantum hardware claim.
Same-environment deterministic identity is tested, not cross-platform reproduction.
